description: Get your seller account overview: agent profile, plan and listing limit, payout wallet, and every listing you own with its status (draft, pending, active, hidden or paused_over_plan_limit), moderator note and views. Use get_balance for money, get_stats for traffic over time and get_sales for individual sales. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.
